justification: New API endpoint /pipeline/intelligence-brief — touches data integrity (LGA validation Fix A), strata routing (apartment vs development brief), minimum viable brief rejection. 4 files changed including new test file. Critical because wrong brief type or wrong LGA = wrong data served.

pre_impl.existing_data: Existing service functions: resolve_address, parse_controls, get_valuation, get_unique_overlays, detect_strata, detect_former_council, get_nearby_das, get_shadow_risk, fetch_dcp_setbacks, fetch_heritage_postgis, fetch_sepp_housing_standards. All called via _safe_call wrapper.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: parse_controls returns dict with keys like 'zone', 'height', 'fsr' — if key names change upstream, DataField wrapping silently returns None. Mitigated: parity test against conveyancing output.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New endpoint only — no existing data modified. All queries are read-only SELECT on existing tables.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Planning Portal timeout/500 → _safe_call returns DataField(not_available). VG API failure → same. PostGIS timeout → same. Shadow pipeline down → same. Each failure isolated, doesn't cascade.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend changes. Backend endpoint only.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: If >30% fields fail: 503 with gap list. If address outside NSW: 422. If address unresolvable: 422. Normal failures: brief returned with not_available fields and gap disclosure.

functions.name: run_intelligence_brief
functions.if_none: address is required (min_length=5). If resolve_address returns None lat/lng → 422.

functions.name: _validate_former_council_postgis
functions.output: tuple(validated_slug, advisory_message) — slug may be corrected or None
functions.if_none: If DB connection fails → returns (text_slug, None) — trusts text match as fallback

functions.name: _build_planning_controls
functions.input: controls dict from parse_controls, overlays_data dict
functions.if_none: Empty controls dict → all DataField values are None with AUTHORITATIVE confidence (portal returned nothing)

values.if_missing: Falls back to empty controls dict — all planning fields show not_available in brief

values.nullable: yes — may be None if address not in known LGA
values.guard_at: services/intelligence_brief.py:760 — _fetch_dcp_controls checks None and returns None → DCP controls show not_available with reason
values.if_missing: DCP section shows gap: 'Former council could not be determined'

values.nullable: yes — VG API may not return lot area
values.guard_at: services/intelligence_brief.py:711 — used in classify_strata which handles None (returns AMBIGUOUS)
values.if_missing: Strata classification falls to AMBIGUOUS → conservative RenovationBrief. SEPP Housing eligibility check skipped.

values.nullable: yes — Railway shadow pipeline may be down
values.guard_at: services/intelligence_brief.py:728 — shadow_df.value (None if failed). _build_neighbourhood handles None shadow → NOT_AVAILABLE
values.if_missing: Shadow section shows not_available with reason 'Shadow pipeline unavailable'

queries.purpose: PostGIS LGA validation — cross-check text-based former council against spatial boundary
queries.where_clause: lookup_lga(lat, lng, conn) — internally queries spatial_overlays WHERE ST_Contains(geom, point)
queries.if_zero: Returns text_slug unchanged — trusts text match
queries.if_wrong: Wrong LGA returned by PostGIS → wrong former council → wrong DCP controls. Mitigated: PostGIS is authoritative for geometry.

queries.purpose: DCP setback controls for former council
queries.where_clause: WHERE lga = %s AND is_current = TRUE (via fetch_dcp_setbacks)
queries.if_zero: Returns None → DCP section shows not_available gap
queries.if_wrong: Wrong lga_slug → wrong DCP controls. Mitigated by Fix A PostGIS validation.

queries.if_zero: Empty list → no SEPP standards shown
queries.if_wrong: Wrong zone_code → wrong standards. Zone comes from Planning Portal (authoritative).

break_it.scenario: Planning Portal returns valid JSON but for wrong property (geocode offset 50m near lot boundary)
break_it.what_happens: Brief shows zone/height/FSR for adjacent lot — user sees plausible but wrong controls for their property
break_it.how: Partially mitigated: _validate_coordinates checks NSW bbox. Lot polygon containment check deferred to v2 (requires lot geometry in response).
break_it.repro: POST /pipeline/intelligence-brief with address near a zone boundary (e.g. where R2 meets R3) and check if zone matches council zoning map

break_it.scenario: detect_former_council says 'marrickville' but PostGIS says property is in City of Sydney (Stanmore boundary)
break_it.what_happens: Without Fix A: wrong DCP setbacks served. With Fix A: PostGIS corrects slug to None, DCP shows not_available with advisory explaining the mismatch
break_it.how: services/intelligence_brief.py:625 — _validate_former_council_postgis returns (None, advisory) when PostGIS disagrees with text match
break_it.repro: POST with address '1 Stanmore Rd Stanmore NSW' — Fix A gate: check advisory in gaps, DCP should show not_available

break_it.scenario: DCP query returns controls for wrong zone because lot was recently rezoned (R2→R3) but DCP table has no zone column
break_it.what_happens: User sees dwelling_house setbacks without awareness that multi-dwelling housing is now permitted in R3
break_it.how: Deferred to Stage 3 Fix B (zone dev_type advisory compound constraint). Stage 2 returns DCP controls as-is.
break_it.repro: POST with R3-zoned address — verify DCP controls returned but no zone advisory yet (Stage 3 will add this)

break_it.scenario: 4 of 6 parallel pipeline calls timeout simultaneously (Planning Portal + VG + PostGIS + ePlanning all down)
break_it.what_happens: _safe_call returns NOT_AVAILABLE for each. check_minimum_viable counts 12+ not_available out of 32 total (37.5%) → 503 with gap list
break_it.how: services/intelligence_brief.py:536 — check_minimum_viable rejects brief if <70% available. 503 response includes field count and gap list.
break_it.repro: Mock all external calls to raise TimeoutError → assert 503 response with correct gap count

break_it.scenario: Strata townhouse (lot_area=450m², is_strata=true) — classify_strata returns AMBIGUOUS, brief uses RenovationBrief (no DCP/SEPP/neighbourhood)
break_it.what_happens: User misses development potential information because strata townhouse is treated as apartment. Conservative but informationally incomplete.
break_it.how: services/intelligence_brief.py:479 — classify_strata returns AMBIGUOUS for 400-2500m² strata lots. AMBIGUOUS → RenovationBrief is the safe default. Strata type is shown in response so user can see the classification.
break_it.repro: POST with strata townhouse address (e.g. townhouse complex with 450m² lot) — verify brief_type='renovation' and strata.strata_type='ambiguous'

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — POST to /pipeline/intelligence-brief on Railway with an Inner West address (e.g. '10 Smith St Marrickville NSW 2204'). Verify: brief_type=development, planning_controls populated, DCP controls populated with marrickville data, shadow section present, SEPP housing standards present, confidence_summary shows mostly authoritative.
